negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of a standalone ČNB 'CERTIS ročenka' (CERTIS yearbook) as a separate publication. Annual CERTIS figures appear to be carried in the CERTIS statistical-data pages and in the ČNB Výroční zpráva rather than in a dedicated annual volume.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Czech for 'CERTIS ročenka' returned the CERTIS statistics page, the instant-payments pages and the ČNB annual report, but no separate yearbook publication.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not wait on a yearbook that may not exist; annual CERTIS aggregates must be sourced from the statistics page plus the annual report.

negative_findings.description: ČNB open data appears to cover registers (banks, bureaux de change, credit intermediaries) rather than the payment/card/ATM statistical series. No SDMX endpoint for ČNB was identified; ARAD exposes a proprietary REST API instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching for ČNB SDMX returned only ECB/UNICEF SDMX material plus the ARAD REST API PDF. The ČNB open-data page enumerates register-type datasets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline assuming SDMX compatibility with ECB tooling will fail for CZ national series; the ARAD REST contract must be implemented separately.

negative_findings.description: Institution-level (bank-by-bank) payment, card and terminal data reported via SDAT under reports PSSIVYC22 / PSSIVYP22 is not publicly available; only ČNB aggregates are published.
negative_findings.result_summary: The reporting-methodology pages describe the granular fields, but the SDAT application requires registered reporting-entity credentials.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level card/ATM/POS shares cannot be obtained from ČNB and must be triangulated from other cells (acquirers, card schemes, bank annual reports).

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live by this agent; all URLs come from search-result metadata and snowballing. Several are deep PDF/gallery paths that change between publication cycles.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores only; liveness is deferred to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deep .galleries/download/*.pdf paths on cnb.cz are the most likely to 404 after a site reorganisation; the verifier should re-resolve them from their index pages rather than marking them dead.

coverage_gaps.description: ČNB publishes only national aggregates for cards, ATMs and POS terminals; no issuer-, acquirer- or scheme-level breakdown and no merchant-category detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cover this from adjacent cells: card schemes (Visa/Mastercard CZ), acquirers, the Czech Banking Association, and individual bank annual reports; use ČNB aggregates as the control total.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment statistics are quarterly/semi-annual with a substantial publication lag, whereas CERTIS volumes are monthly. Card and terminal counts therefore update far more slowly than transaction volumes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Anchor high-frequency tracking on CERTIS and instant-payment releases; treat card/ATM/POS counts as a semi-annual structural update and document the lag explicitly in every derived metric.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment statistics were re-based in 2022 following ECB Reg. (EU) 2020/2011 and CZ Decree 401/2021 Sb., with new report codes and a new coding scheme for payments. Pre-2022 and post-2022 series are not automatically comparable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Record the 2022 break as a hard boundary in the series metadata; retain the ČNB methodology pages as the citation, and avoid joining pre/post-2022 series without an explicit bridge.

coverage_gaps.description: ARAD is a JavaScript SPA with hash routing; the underlying REST API surface, indicator identifiers and rate limits have not been enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicate an engineering spike to parsing the ARAD-REST-API PDF and enumerating the payment-statistics and currency-in-circulation set/indicator IDs before building the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: The English mirror of cnb.cz was confirmed to exist for the main statistics, CERTIS and payments pages, but English mirrors were not located for the deeper methodology and reporting pages (vykazování, metodické poznámky) or for the cnBlog cash posts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Collect the Czech originals as authoritative for methodology; do not rely on English mirrors for reporting-framework detail, and note where an English version may lag or be absent.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-usage evidence from ČNB is supply-side (currency in circulation, denominations, counterfeits). ČNB payment-diary or consumer cash-behaviour survey material was not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search specifically for ČNB/ECB SPACE-style consumer payment-behaviour studies for CZ in a follow-up, and cover demand-side cash behaviour from survey cells.

brief: The Czech National Bank is an unusually dense and well-structured single source for this cell: it is simultaneously the statistical compiler (ARAD time series plus the semi-annual payment-statistics release covering cards, ATMs and POS acceptance devices), the operator of the only CZK interbank system (CERTIS, with monthly volumes and instant-payment data), the sole currency issuer (peněžní oběh / oběživo statistics), and the licensing authority whose JERRS register maps every payment institution. Machine access is realistic but bespoke — ARAD offers a documented REST API rather than SDMX, and the JERRS web services provide structured register snapshots; the published open-data catalogue covers registers, not statistical series. The two hard limits are granularity (national aggregates only; institution-level payment and terminal reporting sits inside the credentialed SDAT platform) and comparability (a 2022 methodology break under ECB Reg. (EU) 2020/2011 and Decree 401/2021 Sb.). All URLs here are unverified by this agent and several are deep PDF gallery paths that should be re-resolved from their index pages rather than treated as dead on a single failed fetch.
